record.question: Who was the Indian Diplomat arrested in America on visa fraud charges?
record.explanation: Answer D: Ms. Devyani Khobragade. Devyani Khobragade was the Indian consular officer arrested in New York on 12 December 2013 on visa-fraud and false-statement charges. The US Attorney's contemporary announcement identifies her. These were allegations/charges, not a finding of guilt. Historical/source note: Describes the arrest and allegations in 2013, not a conviction. Reference: https://www.justice.gov/archive/usao/nys/pressreleases/December13/KhobragadeArrestPR.php. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
